items.title: 61125_Teddy Bunn oral history interview
items.q: God rest his soul, Leo threw things out the window. Seventh floor. He was so drunk off of gin. At a party we played in Florida.

ctx.x: Yeah. Right on 7th Avenue. God rest his soul, Leo threw things out the window. Seventh floor. He was so drunk off of gin. At a party we played in Florida.
I've always been amazed that his sense of pitch never went off, you know? To drink that much and be right on the money.
